description: Verdict from 'gc agent is-foreign': whose roster an assignee identity belongs to. The EXIT CODE is the primary contract for shell callers — 0 local, 1 foreign, 2 cannot-answer — and this document is emitted for all three. 'ok' is true whenever the verb ran: a 'foreign' verdict is an answer, not a failure.

identity.description: The identity asked about, echoed back.

verdict.description: Matches the exit code. 'local' means this city can answer the identity's liveness — NOT that it is alive. 'foreign' means protect it. 'unknown' means this city cannot answer; protect it and count it separately.

reason.description: The narrowing that decided the verdict. 'foreign_binding' (another city's canonical naming, ga-8yi7ne) and 'absent_from_roster' (possibly one of ours, decommissioned) call for different operator responses, so callers should report this per protected identity.

detail.description: The narrowing's subject: the matched roster candidate, the foreign binding that blocked every candidate, or why the verb could not answer.

roster_source.description: Where the roster was read from, with resolved agent and rig counts so a surprising verdict can be triaged from this document alone. A roster reporting 0 agents is a config-resolution failure wearing a successful load.
